scientific_integrity: Exact proof by finite graph component enumeration and a sharp polynomial-sign classification; an independently coded exhaustive rational test enumerates all bonds and imported seeds for household sizes at most three, with 2533 assertions. Finite tests are not a proof of continuous parameter claims.
scientific_limitations: Isolated identical complete three-vertex households, two perfectly effective vaccine doses, independent Bernoulli introductions and undirected percolation bonds, expected eventual case count. No claim for general continuous-time SIR models or arbitrary households. Historical priority provisional, especially inaccessible full Ball–Lyne (2002) text.
title: An exact vaccine-allocation crossover for two three-person households
